data.name: Onb_P1_Intro
data.value: Rebornix backs up the important things to a second drive before you reinstall, and puts them all back in the right order afterwards. This short guide walks you through it step by step.

data.name: Onb_P1_Steps
data.value: Back up: BEFORE reinstalling, saves your drivers, Wi-Fi passwords, app list, game saves and Windows settings. Restore: AFTER reinstalling, brings it all back in order: drivers → Wi-Fi → apps → game saves → settings. Quick Install: installs apps like Chrome, Steam and Discord on a clean PC in one click. Rebornix needs no installation; it's a single .exe file that keeps its settings and logs in its own folder.

data.name: Onb_P1_Tip
data.value: You can open this guide any time with the "How does it work?" button on the Home page.

data.name: Onb_P2_Title
data.value: Put it in the right place first

data.name: Onb_P2_Intro
data.value: A reinstall wipes the C: drive completely. Your backup and Rebornix itself must live somewhere that won't be erased.

data.name: Onb_P2_Steps
data.value: Copy Rebornix.exe to a second drive (e.g. D:), an external drive or a USB stick and run it from there. Choose that drive as the backup target too. If you pick C:, the app stops you with a big red warning. Make sure there is enough free space (game saves can take a few GB). Using it for the first time? Turn on Settings → Dry run: you'll see what would happen without changing anything. The app asks for administrator permission when it starts; it needs this for drivers and Wi-Fi.

data.name: Onb_P2_Tip
data.value: Before reinstalling, open the backup folder (e.g. D:\Rebornix) and make sure you see the Drivers, WiFi, Data and Backups folders inside.

data.name: Onb_P3_Title
data.value: What should I do on the Back up page?

data.name: Onb_P3_Intro
data.value: Open "Back up" from the menu on the left and follow these steps in order:

data.name: Onb_P3_Steps
data.value: Backup target: choose your second drive. The backup is written to the Rebornix folder on it. Drivers: leave it on. Network/Wi-Fi drivers are marked "Critical"; you need them to get online after the reinstall. Wi-Fi passwords: turn on if you want. Your saved network passwords are encrypted with a password you choose. Don't forget it! App list: leave it on. Which programs are installed is recorded and they are installed automatically after the reinstall. Game saves: press "Scan games" and untick the ones you don't want. Add save folders it can't find with "Add folder". Windows settings: theme, wallpaper, taskbar, mouse and similar settings are saved. Press "Start backup" and check that the summary at the end shows no errors.

data.name: Onb_P3_Tip
data.value: The backup never deletes or changes your files; it only reads and copies them.

data.name: Onb_P4_Intro
data.value: Rebornix doesn't copy your personal files automatically. Before reinstalling, secure these yourself:

data.name: Onb_P4_Steps
data.value: Personal folders: copy Desktop, Documents, Pictures, Videos, Music and Downloads to a second or external drive. Browser: sign in to Chrome/Edge/Firefox and turn on sync; that's how passwords and bookmarks come back. Accounts: make sure you have your authenticator (two-step verification) backup codes and know your important passwords. Licenses: note down Office, game and software license keys. Your Windows license is usually tied to your Microsoft account. If you use BitLocker, save your recovery key (aka.ms/myrecoverykey). Other important files: email archives (Outlook .pst), projects that aren't in the cloud, phone backups.

data.name: Onb_P4_Tip
data.value: Once everything is copied, unplug the backup drive (if it's external) so it can't be wiped by accident during the reinstall.

data.name: Onb_P5_Title
data.value: Run these in order after Windows is installed

data.name: Onb_P5_Intro
data.value: Plug in your backup drive, open Rebornix.exe from the Rebornix folder and go to the "Restore" page. The backup is found automatically.

data.name: Onb_P5_Steps
data.value: Drivers: run this first. Network drivers are installed first. If a restart is needed, restart and open Rebornix again; it continues where it left off. Wi-Fi: enter your backup password; your networks are added and the internet is checked. If it doesn't connect, pick your network from the list and press "Connect". Apps: if you're online, the saved apps are installed silently one by one. Apps already installed are skipped. Game saves: run this after signing in to your game platforms (Steam etc.). On conflicts, "Keep the newer one" is recommended. Windows settings: the settings you choose come back. If you don't like them, undo on the "Windows Settings" page. Check "Retry failed" and the "Install manually" list at the bottom.

data.name: Onb_P5_Tip
data.value: You can also press "Run all in order" to do everything at once; you'll be asked to confirm every important step.

data.name: Onb_P6_Intro
data.value: When the restore is done, to get your PC fully ready:

data.name: Onb_P6_Steps
data.value: Run Windows Update and install all updates. Get the latest graphics driver from the manufacturer's site (NVIDIA / AMD / Intel); the backed-up driver is a temporary fix. On the "Quick Install" page, pick any missing apps and install them together. You can save your usual selection as a profile. Download the programs on the "Install manually" list from their makers' websites. Sign in to your browser, activate your licenses and copy your personal files back.

data.name: Onb_P6_Tip
data.value: If something goes wrong, the Logs page shows what happened; a system restore point is also offered before driver and settings changes.
